title: Episode title — United's Tarmac Nightmare, a Rocket Blows Up Delta's Wi-Fi Bet, and Philippine Airlines Goes Big on Boeing
summary: United passengers spent up to eight hours stuck on the O'Hare tarmac during Friday's meltdown, and then United broke again on Monday — just because. Plus, there's a real update on the flydubai terror plot, a rocket failure puts a hole in Delta's satellite Wi-Fi plan, and Philippine Airlines drops $3.4 billion on Dreamliners.
